description: Create a new pull request, including reviewers, linked work items, and optional tags

additionalProperties.description: Additional properties to set on the pull request

description.description: The description of the pull request (markdown is supported)

isDraft.description: Whether the pull request should be created as a draft

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

repositoryId.description: The ID or name of the repository

reviewers.description: List of reviewer email addresses or IDs

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the pull request

title.description: The title of the pull request

workItemRefs.description: List of work item IDs to link to the pull request

name: create_pull_request
